title: Charges for Overdraft Protection Transfers on Personal Checking
content:
Where funds move from a linked savings account to cover an item on a Personal Checking account, the tier's overdraft protection transfer charge applies to the transfer, and the tier's daily maximum is the largest number of such charges one account can incur on one business day.

| Tier | Charge per overdraft protection transfer (USD) | Most transfer charges on one account on one business day |
|---|---|---|
| Access Checking | 0.00 | 0 |
| Student Checking | 0.00 | 0 |
| Everyday Checking | 10.00 | 1 |
| Interest Checking | 10.00 | 1 |
| Premier Checking | 0.00 | 0 |
| Private Client Checking | 0.00 | 0 |

A charge of 0.00 means no charge row is written for a transfer on that tier.

**Points of judgement.** Only Everyday Checking and Interest Checking carry a transfer charge, and on both the daily maximum is 1, so a second transfer on the same business day carries no further charge. On the four tiers whose charge is 0.00 the daily maximum reads 0 and no transfer charge ever arises.
